faqs.question: What is Krillion Unlimited?
faqs.answer: Krillion Unlimited is the unconstrained practice mode of Krillion. It lets you play unlimited consecutive trivia rounds, explore past daily archives, and practice without waiting for the midnight New York reset.

faqs.question: Can I play themed decks like Pokemon and Minecraft?
faqs.answer: Yes! While the daily dive features mixed general knowledge, unlimited practice mode and community decks allow focused trivia on specific topics like Pokemon, Minecraft, and pop culture.

faqs.question: Is Krillion game powered by AI?
faqs.answer: Krillion utilizes structured entity databases and statistical frequency distributions of player answers to rank rarity tiers (from Plankton to One in a Krillion), rather than generative AI chatbots.

faqs.question: How does Krillion multiplayer work?
faqs.answer: Official multiplayer operates asynchronously through Depth Duels—players share their 7,000-meter scorecard emoji grids to compare depths. Additionally, community recreations exist on platforms like Roblox for live social play.

faqs.question: What games are like Krillion?
faqs.answer: Games like Krillion include Noillirk (the reverse popular-answer version), Semantle (semantic similarity guessing), Contexto (AI word distance ranking), and classic Wordle.

faqs.question: Do Unlimited scores count toward the official daily leaderboard?
faqs.answer: No. Unlimited scores and past dive replays are recorded locally for training and skill-building. Only your first daily run counts toward global leaderboard stats.
